name: plainkeep-cli
description: The plainkeep core binary (compiled TS): dispatcher, guardrail, resolver, TUI, MCP. Phase 1 skeleton — absorbs the legacy plainkeep-ui TUI (cli/src/tui).

scripts.check:bun: bun -e 'const v=Bun.version.split(".").map(Number);const ok=v[0]>1||(v[0]===1&&(v[1]>2||(v[1]===2&&v[2]>=21)));if(!ok){console.error(`plainkeep-core needs bun >= 1.2.21, found ${Bun.version}. Older bun DROPS empty-string entries when spawning a child, so the dispatcher would silently eat an empty verb argument (verified broken on 1.1.45 and 1.2.0, fixed on 1.2.21 and 1.3.14). Fix: bun upgrade`);process.exit(1)}'
scripts.build: bun run check:bun && bun build --compile src/core/main.ts --outfile ../.local/bin/plainkeep-core
